review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 5542 constructs a quasi-isomorphism A→B of DG O-algebras with A both graded-flat and K-flat as an O-complex, requiring both properties to remain true after pullback along ANY morphism of ringed topoi. The prepared statement retains both simultaneous flatness properties and the universal pullback qualifier.
statement:
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $(\mathcal{B}, \text{d})$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebra.
There exists a quasi-isomorphism of differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebras
$(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}) \to (\mathcal{B}, \text{d})$ such that
$\mathcal{A}$ is graded flat and K-flat as a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules
and such that the same is true after pullback by any morphism of
ringed topoi.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-good-dga}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $(\mathcal{B}, \text{d})$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebra.
There exists a quasi-isomorphism of differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebras
$(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}) \to (\mathcal{B}, \text{d})$ such that
$\mathcal{A}$ is graded flat and K-flat as a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules
and such that the same is true after pullback by any morphism of
ringed topoi.
